caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile pattern composed primarily of horizontal bands. The bands alternate in color and texture, with dominant hues of red, yellow, gold, green, pink, black, and off-white. The composition consists of sections of tightly packed parallel lines and areas where vertical and horizontal stitches are visible, creating a woven effect. Red is the most prominent color, used in solid bands as well as in checkerboard and striped arrangements, while yellow or gold bands are interspersed, including two wide gold sections. Black is used as thin dividing lines between the different colored bands, and some bands are made up of a mix of white, green, and pink threads, giving a mottled appearance. The overall structure is symmetrical, with similar patterns mirrored above and below the center horizontal axis, and the pattern is bordered at the top and bottom edges by narrow, dark-colored bands. The background of the image is plain and light beige, providing contrast to the more vibrant colors of the textile pattern.
title: Woven Wool Carpet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
